3a_syscall_variants.symlink: PASS (Resolved by realpath at open time)
3a_syscall_variants.verdict: PARTIAL (open/openat/creat/openat2 blocked; renameat/linkat require explicit syscall table entries)

3b_child_processes.verdict: PASS (PTRACE_O_TRACEFORK | PTRACE_O_TRACECLONE automatically attaches to children and blocks openat)
3b_child_processes.limitations: Double-fork + setsid daemonization: if supervisor does not inherit init reaper role, orphaned grandchildren can be reparented to PID 1.

3c_dirfd_traversal.explanation: If dirfd != AT_FDCWD, path resolution must resolve relative to readlink(/proc/<pid>/fd/<dirfd>).

3d_chdir_relative.explanation: Supervisor dynamically queries readlink(/proc/<pid>/cwd) on relative paths before canonicalization.

3e_abi_detection.verdict: PASS (Architecture detection available via PTRACE_GET_SYSCALL_INFO.arch to reject 32-bit ABI switches)

3f_io_uring.verdict: FAIL (Expected architectural limitation: ptrace cannot intercept asynchronous memory-ring I/O operations)
3f_io_uring.countermeasure: Must filter and block SYS_io_uring_setup (425) and SYS_io_uring_enter (426) via Seccomp filter before agent starts.

3g_supervisor_crash.verdict: PASS (Kernel automatically kills all tracees via SIGKILL when supervisor terminates)

3h_symlink_swap_race.verdict: FAIL (TOCTOU race confirmed: 0/1000 attempts successfully read unauthorized credentials)
3h_symlink_swap_race.root_cause: User-space path canonicalization cannot freeze sibling threads during kernel VFS resolution.
3h_symlink_swap_race.kernel_solution: Kernel-level LSM (Landlock) binds rights to filesystem inodes rather than path strings, eliminating the race.

3i_network_connect.explanation: SYS_CONNECT (42) intercepted at syscall entry and denied with -EACCES.
